_provenance: Measurement-noise model of the generator, declared once so physiology.measure and the independent clinical audit (audit/clinical.py, which never imports the generator) read the same parameters. Per-analyte within-subject CVs (CVI) live in indicators.json, from the EFLM biological-variation database; the entries here are the remaining model choices.
distribution: lognormal: value = offset + centre * exp(e - s^2/2), e ~ N(0, s^2), s = sqrt(ln(1 + c^2)), c^2 = CVI^2 + CVA^2 as fractions, so the printed values' CV is c (Fokkema et al., Clin Chem 2006;52:1602-3, the lognormal reference change value)

notes.default_cvi_percent: used for an analyte the catalogue gives no CVI
notes.cva_percent: one analytical CV for every analyte: it keeps a repeat measurement from being identical, it does not reproduce a particular instrument
notes.cva_override_percent: a thermometer reads to about 0.1 degC; 3% of 37 degC would be +/-1 degC
notes.offset: noise and effects act on value - offset (urine specific gravity is 1 plus the solute load)
notes.ceiling: physical ceilings real instruments cannot cross; values are clamped there
notes.compositional: the white-cell differential percentages are rescaled to sum to 100 after sampling
notes.noise_free: height is fixed and weight follows the weight trajectory without measurement noise
